recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast portrait of a man wearing a cowboy hat, where half the face is submerged in deep shadow and the other half is warmly lit. The composition uses a horizontal typographic band across the center and secondary text at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme contrast between the pitch-black shadow and the warm, golden skin tones
The brim of the hat creates a sharp diagonal divide across the upper third
Typography bridges the gap between the dark and light halves of the face
Intense eye contact directed at the viewer from the lit side of the face
coreInvariants: Wide tracking in the primary display text
Close-up framing focusing on the eyes and mouth

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, face fills the entire frame with the nose acting as the vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The lit eye on the right side of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the lit eye, moves down to the smirk, then across the horizontal text line, finishing at the bottom subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left half of the image is dominated by heavy, solid black negative space.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and ochre (skin tones and highlights)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White (typography and catchlights in the eye)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast; the image relies on light intensity rather than color variety.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and monochrome

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast in the main display face
Extremely wide letter spacing (tracking) for the primary name
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; standard glyphs used to maintain legibility against complex background

composition.relationshipToImage: anchors the bottom of the frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A formal, spaced-out uppercase serif paired with a smaller, intimate lowercase italic serif.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment across the facial midline

candidateDirections.reason: Classic transitional serif with high contrast and elegant terminals.
Extreme stroke contrast matches the high-contrast lighting of the photo.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, warm-toned close-up portrait of a man with a beard wearing a dark cowboy hat. Use side-lighting so half the face is in total shadow. The lit side should have golden, sun-kissed skin tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase serif text across the middle of the face with very wide tracking. Add a smaller line of italicized lowercase serif text at the bottom center. All text should be pure white.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting split exactly down the middle?
Is the tracking on the main text wide enough to span the face?
Is the color palette restricted to warm earth tones and black?

adjustableVariables: Amount of tracking in the display text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness issues
Any specific brand logos or trademarked insignias

mustAchieve: Legible white text over both dark and light areas
Sharp focus on the visible eye

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the hat brim creates a clear diagonal line.
Check that the text does not obscure the eye.
Verify the 'glow' or warmth of the lit skin side.
Confirm the bottom text is small and centered.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast split-lit portrait + Wide-tracked uppercase serif + Bottom-anchored italic subtitle.
